## Find the next step {#find-next}

- **By quest:** [Opening and new home, Q1–10](journey.html#journey-group-start) · [Across the mainland, Q11–14](journey.html#journey-group-travel) · [Voyage and finale, Q15–17](journey.html#journey-group-finale)
- **By location:** [Castle lobby](#castle-help) · [Femura mine](#mine-help) · [Regull Port](#port-help)

### Lemuria Castle lobby {#castle-help}

- **Haven't seen the King yet:** [Find out whom to speak to](journey.qmd#castle-audience).
- **Have the Blue House Key, but no new quest:** [Find Clyde after the audience](journey.qmd#lemuria-next).
- **Already on Our New Home:** [Find the house](journey.qmd#visit-new-home).

### Femura mine {#mine-help}

- **Haven't ridden a cart yet:** [Check the first four Wheel locations](journey.qmd#four-wheels-cart).
- **Already rode the first cart and are by the ore piles:** [Find the second set of Wheels](journey.qmd#second-cart).

### Regull Port {#port-help}

- **The residents aren’t talking about passage:** [Start asking about passage](journey.qmd#regull-arrival).
- **Talked to all four residents, but still can't sail:** [Pick up the captain's assignment](journey.qmd#emerald-next).
- **Won a Behemoth fight but didn't get a Claw:** [Find another Behemoth](journey.qmd#behemoth-proof).
- **Have a Claw already:** [Return to the captain](journey.qmd#behemoth-voyage).

### Other common roadblocks {#more-stuck}

- [Can't find Gali Root for the household's Fried Meat](journey.qmd#home-cooking).
- [Reached Fort Aridale, but the journal still says Our New Home](journey.qmd#fort-aridale-handoff).
- [Won the Redsea ruins altar fight, but Q11 is still open](journey.qmd#redsea-altar).
- [Artellus's west exit is sending you back to the inn](journey.qmd#artellus-next).

Equipment

### Craft an ultimate weapon

Choose between Alpha's Bond, Omega's Wish, Loyal Link, and Wishing Star before spending your Mythril.

[See where to get all four](equipment.qmd#ultimate)
:::
::: {.goal-card}
::: {.goal-tag}
Exploration and battles
:::
### Try a realm or the arena

The four elemental realms award different core recipes. Arena challenges earn medals you can spend in the shop.

[See realm routes and arena challenges](exploration.qmd)
:::
::: {.goal-card}
::: {.goal-tag}
Extra story
:::
### Unlock the third memory

Two late side quests unlock the extra Snowbell scene. Play that scene before trying to replay it as a memory.

[Check the scene and replay requirements](memories.qmd#third-scene)
:::
::::

## How the late-game goals connect {#connections}

::: {.relation}
Union Link leads to the Omega's Wish recipe and the extra scene. The King's Request opens the expanded medal shop and the Darkspore Portal branch, which awards the Wishing Star Recipe. You also need it for the extra scene.
:::
